commands.describe.default.title: Run a command
commands.describe.release.forced.title: Release without a releasing commit
commands.describe.release.forced.why: No commit releases this package. The new tag points at HEAD, and the same code is published under a new version, with a GitHub Release and the assets. It cannot be undone.
commands.describe.release.title: Release
commands.describe.release.why: This versions every package with releasable commits, publishes it to the registry and pushes its tags. It cannot be undone.
commands.describe.doctor.only.title: Apply one doctor fix
commands.describe.doctor.only.why: This applies the safe fix of the chosen check and rewrites the files listed below.
commands.describe.doctor.title: Fix with doctor
commands.describe.doctor.why: This applies the safe fixes doctor found and rewrites files.
commands.describe.install.packages.title: Install packages
commands.describe.install.packages.why: This adds the packages to the projects below with each project's own package manager, and updates its lock file.
commands.describe.install.title: Install everything
commands.describe.install.why: This installs what every project already declares, with its own toolchain (as after a fresh clone). To add one package, use Install a package instead.
commands.describe.upgrade.title: Upgrade the workspace
commands.describe.upgrade.why: This updates smith.toml to the current format and rewrites the files smith manages.
commands.describe.ci.title: Regenerate CI pipelines
commands.describe.ci.why: This rewrites the pipeline files smith owns.
commands.describe.add.title: Add a project
commands.describe.add.why: This creates the project's files and registers it in the workspace.
commands.describe.remove.title: Remove a project
commands.describe.remove.why: This deletes the project's directory and its traces in the workspace.
commands.describe.new.title: Create a workspace
commands.describe.new.why: This creates a directory with smith.toml, git and CI pipelines.
commands.describe.config.title: Change a setting
commands.describe.deps.align.title: Align dependency versions
commands.describe.deps.align.why: This rewrites manifests so each dependency has one version across the workspace, then installs.
commands.describe.deps.title: Update dependencies
commands.describe.deps.why: This moves the chosen dependencies to their latest release in every project that declares them, then installs.
commands.describe.swap.title: Swap a choice
commands.describe.swap.why: This replaces one choice of the project, such as its test runner, moves what the old choice wrote, installs and runs its tests.
commands.describe.bootstrap.title: Write the launcher
commands.describe.bootstrap.why: This writes tools/smith/smith and tools/smith/smith.cmd. They run the smith version that smith.toml pins.
commands.describe.commit.title: Commit these changes
commands.describe.commit.why: This commits every file listed below as one commit that smith undo can revert. Check the list: a change of your own in the same work tree goes with it.
commands.describe.undo.title: Undo the last change
commands.describe.undo.why: This reverts the last change smith made with a new commit. Your history stays as it is.
commands.describe.agent.title: Write the agent file
commands.describe.agent.why: This writes AGENTS.md, and a short CLAUDE.md that imports it, from what smith knows about the workspace.
commands.describe.derive.eject.title: Own a derived file
commands.describe.derive.eject.why: This marks the file as yours. smith stops rewriting it.
commands.describe.derive.adopt.title: Keep your edit of a derived file
commands.describe.derive.adopt.why: This takes your edit as the new baseline. smith keeps it and rewrites the rest.
commands.describe.derive.replace.title: Replace a derived file
commands.describe.derive.replace.why: This overwrites the file with what smith derives. Your edit is lost.
commands.describe.derive.title: Update the derived files
commands.describe.derive.why: This rewrites the files that follow from the project graph. A file you edited is never overwritten.
commands.describe.plugin.install.title: Install a plugin
commands.describe.plugin.install.why: This puts the plugin on this machine after checking it. smith does not start it.
commands.describe.plugin.title: Change plugins
commands.describe.recipe.title: Write a recipe
commands.describe.recipe.why: This writes {file} in the current folder, after it checks that the recipe resolves. A file that exists is not replaced.
commands.describe.other.title: Run smith {verb}
commands.describe.other.why: This command changes the workspace or publishes.
